title: pix_tIIRf
description: time-based IIR filter for images, with typed coefficients

messages.description: feedback coefficient (one inlet per feedback tap)
feedforward coefficient (one inlet per feedforward tap)

methods.description: fill the filter buffers with the next image (or blank them with a value)

body: Like [pix_tIIR], [pix_tIIRf] filters each pixel over time. Its arguments set the number of taps: after the gemlist inlet come one inlet per feedback coefficient, then one per feedforward coefficient.
